faq.question: What does Ebrahim mean?

faq.question: What is the origin of Ebrahim?

faq.question: Is Ebrahim an Arabic name?
faq.answer: No — the underlying form is Hebrew, not Arabic.

faq.question: Is Ebrahim an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Ebrahim can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Hebrew-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
